name: Conservative Formula Vol Screen
note: Blitz and van Vliet's sequential construction: screen on volatility FIRST, rank on momentum SECOND, never a composite score. The published rule is cross-sectional (keep the calmest half of a 500-name universe, then buy the top decile of that half by 12-month return); a single-symbol harness has no cross-section, so each name is ranked against its OWN trailing distribution instead - the volatility percentile must sit below screen_pct and only then must the momentum percentile sit in the top sel_pct. The net-payout-yield leg of the published formula is a fundamental field this bot does not have and is dropped, exactly as the idea specifies. The selection is re-evaluated only every rebal bars (the monthly rebalance) and held in between, and the position is a CONDITION TO BE IN, so exit_on_zero is set.
source: backtrader blog, 'Rebalancing - Conservative Formula', implementing Blitz and van Vliet, 'The Conservative Formula: Quantitative Investing Made Easy' (SSRN 3145152) - https://www.backtrader.com/blog/2019-07-19-rebalancing-conservative/rebalancing-conservative/
code:
import math


def family_init(ctx):
    b = ctx.bars
    n = len(b)
    c = [float(x["c"]) for x in b]

    mw = max(2, int(ctx.p.mom_win))
    vw = max(20, int(ctx.p.vol_win))
    rw = max(50, int(ctx.p.rank_win))
    rb = max(1, int(ctx.p.rebal))
    keep = float(ctx.p.screen_pct) / 100.0
    sel = float(ctx.p.sel_pct) / 100.0

    # ---- log returns ----
    r = [0.0] * n
    for j in range(1, n):
        a = c[j - 1]
        if a > 0.0 and c[j] > 0.0:
            r[j] = math.log(c[j] / a)

    # ---- the LONG volatility window: stdev of returns over vw bars ----
    vol = [None] * n
    s1 = 0.0
    s2 = 0.0
    for j in range(1, n):
        s1 += r[j]
        s2 += r[j] * r[j]
        if j - vw >= 1:
            k = j - vw
            s1 -= r[k]
            s2 -= r[k] * r[k]
        m = j if j < vw else vw
        if m >= 20:
            mu = s1 / m
            v = s2 / m - mu * mu
            vol[j] = math.sqrt(v) if v > 0.0 else 0.0

    # ---- momentum: total return over mw bars ----
    mom = [None] * n
    for j in range(mw, n):
        a = c[j - mw]
        if a > 0.0:
            mom[j] = c[j] / a - 1.0

    # ---- the sequential screen, re-run only on rebalance bars ----
    hold = [0] * n
    state = 0
    start = max(vw, mw) + rw
    for j in range(n):
        if j >= start and (j - start) % rb == 0:
            state = 0
            v = vol[j]
            m = mom[j]
            if v is not None and m is not None:
                lo = j - rw
                nv = 0
                cv = 0
                nm = 0
                cm = 0
                for k in range(lo, j):
                    vk = vol[k]
                    if vk is not None:
                        nv += 1
                        if vk < v:
                            cv += 1
                    mk = mom[k]
                    if mk is not None:
                        nm += 1
                        if mk < m:
                            cm += 1
                if nv > 0 and nm > 0:
                    # STEP 1 -- the volatility screen. Survive only if this
                    # bar's long-window vol sits in the calm part of the
                    # symbol's own vol distribution.
                    if (cv / nv) <= keep:
                        # STEP 2 -- and only then, rank on momentum.
                        if (cm / nm) >= 1.0 - sel:
                            state = 1
        hold[j] = state
    ctx.hold = ctx.series(hold, "cf_hold")


def signal(ctx, i):
    h = ctx.hold[i]
    if h is None:
        return 0
    return 1 if h else 0
